violation_type.title: Space Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Does Not Limit Movement (26 TAC §746.2603(1))
violation_type.short_title: Space Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Does Not Limit Movement
violation_type.typical_finding: Two children, ages 3 and 4yo, were observed in feeding chairs, which have harnesses and limiting children s movement.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when staff removed the children from the chairs.

finding_variants.text: Two children, ages 3 and 4yo, were observed in feeding chairs, which have harnesses and limiting children s movement.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when staff removed the children from the chairs.
A 3yo child was observed in a high chair during the morning routine.

Two children in the toddler room were observied in high chairs while the rest of the group participated in a craft. One child in the prek room was observed a high chair while rest of the group participated in a craft.
A four year old child was awake and placed on a high chair after waking from naptime.
